svg.title: yak CSS loading
svg.desc: Two page loads on a timeline. With runtime CSS-in-JS, the server renders HTML and CSS, sends inline CSS, the browser loads JS with CSS inside, and the runtime rebuilds and injects the CSS. With yak, a 103 Early Hints response sends the stylesheet right at the request, and the CSS steps fall away.

g.text: The browser builds the CSS again
The server renders the CSS, then the runtime regenerates it in the browser.
The CSS arrives before the HTML
yak sends the stylesheet with 103 Early Hints and skips the runtime CSS work.
